'''Kund Ekorr''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] affiliated with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] who lived in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Ekorr took a seat in the Federation's [[Trade Federation Occupation Council|Occupation Council]]. Their role was [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. During their time as a member of the Occupation Council, they wore an outfit with entirely white fabrics.

During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Ekorr and the other members of the Occupation Council hid in the throne room with [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]]. However, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] managed to enter the throne room and capture Ekorr, along with the other Neimoidians. They were taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to await trial.
